Photo 1 shows the front of the same console with the model name 'PS4' and 'SONY' visible on the side panel.
The console is shown with a plastic protective film still attached to the front.
A USB cable is visible in front of the box in both photos.
The console appears to be a standard model rather than a slim or Pro version.
